film: Fragrant Flower, cards 2-7 (card 1 is the hook, see HOOK-SHOTLIST.md)
rules: LOOP.md sections 2 and 5. Mirror only in the second half of 5B (reveal, formerly 5C) and 7F (ending). Hands are the big dot (cast/b-hands). Every shot starts on a word. Light follows the story: day one late-afternoon gold, next day morning daylight, no night. Merged moves (card 2, 3, 4, 6, 7): one continuous camera move per pair, ids kept from the first shot.

shots.subject: Rintaro on the street, chest-up from the hook, pulling back to his full height by 'tall'. Hands in pockets, then one to the bag strap. Earring glint on 'pierced'.
shots.camera: Pull back and up to a medium, ease to rest
shots.sound: Street air, earring tick on 'pierced'

shots.subject: Two blurred backs in the foreground stop and stiffen on 'intimidating'. He keeps walking, eyes lowered. THEN: The backs streak out sideways, one drops a satchel and a hand snatches it back. He stops and lets out one breath.
shots.camera: Medium, slow push, 4 degree roll THEN: Hold with drift
shots.light: Coolest light of the setup to Cool
shots.sound: Two scuffs; Quick uneven steps panning away
shots.exception: merged move on purpose: the reference median is 2.93 s per shot (the user accepted this in the hook)

shots.subject: Dissolve to the shop. In his apron he sets a cake into the case with both hands. Chairs empty. The camera travels to the one occupied table, a tower of plates.
shots.camera: Wide, then a travel to the table
shots.light: Late-afternoon gold, empty chairs in the light
shots.sound: Case hum, one glass clink, no bell

shots.subject: She eats steadily, untroubled, fork in hand. Plates climb the frame. THEN: The full nine-plate tower with her whole face above it. Glide across to him wiping a plate; he stops wiping.
shots.camera: Medium, rise along the tower to her face THEN: Glide to his medium close-up
shots.light: Gold window to Warm cooling as his tunnel closes
shots.sound: Fork on plate; A plate set down on 'mountain', the cloth stops
shots.exception: merged move on purpose: the reference median is 2.93 s per shot (the user accepted this in the hook)

shots.subject: Her face in the hook's frame-0 framing: close, fork held, eyes lift and lock. This is the exact STARE state, no mirror.
shots.camera: Push, matched to the hook's frame 0
shots.light: Cool grade on her, gold wall
shots.sound: The same fork ticks at the same spacing

shots.subject: She turns in 2-3 frames. One hair streak wipes the frame to the door, already swinging with nobody in it.
shots.camera: Follow the streak, settle on the doorway
shots.light: Smear, then the door in gold
shots.sound: Fork drop, chair, bell, three shrinking steps outside

shots.subject: He sinks behind the case until only his eyes and brow show over it, whole head inside the frame. One blink, breathing.
shots.camera: Slow push
shots.sound: The bell dies away, case hum

shots.subject: Next morning, a dip. She waits behind the door glass with the box in both hands; his blurred arm pushes the leaf open; four weighted steps in. THEN: She bows with the box. He starts to raise a hand and stops. On 'insisting' she straightens and holds the box out.
shots.camera: Medium-wide, feet visible, drift THEN: Medium two-shot, glide in
shots.sound: Bell, hinge, four different contacts; Cloth, one breath
shots.fallback: DEFAULT: waist-up, she glides in with a body bob and no feet in frame; only build the foot walk if time allows
shots.exception: merged move on purpose: the reference median is 2.93 s per shot (the user accepted this in the hook)

shots.subject: At yesterday's table she pushes the box over, he pushes it back, she pushes it again and keeps her hand on it. Both faces above the table. THEN: He looks from the box to her. His brows lift on 'Wait,'.
shots.camera: Medium, high enough for both faces THEN: His close-up, 0.6 percent punch on 'Wait'
shots.sound: Three short slides; Music holds one note
shots.fallback: Show only the box moving between two big-dot hands, faces in the next shot
shots.exception: merged move on purpose: the reference median is 2.93 s per shot (the user accepted this in the hook)

shots.subject: Her face in the hook's frame-0 framing, eyes widening on 'scared'. His reading comes back.
shots.camera: Drift into the frame-0 framing
shots.sound: The room narrows, one tick

shots.subject: REWIND, no freeze. The picture slows and reverses at once through the question, the entrance, the streak and the stare, then lands on frame 0.
shots.camera: Reversed versions of those moves
shots.light: Cold grey, subtle tape tear and scan overlay
shots.sound: Accelerating tape whir, reversed bell, chair and clink

shots.subject: The first frame equals hook frame 0 (captions off). Then the camera rises past the plates on 'HER'. THEN: The plates stop hiding her: full cheek, a crumb, a small closed mouth, not a frightened face. The mirror behind her appears for the first time and shows him watching, as an ordinary boy in an apron.
shots.camera: Rise and push, one continuous move THEN: Settle higher, drift
shots.light: Cool to Focus opens, gold spreads from her window
shots.sound: A clunk on the landing frame, then the tick, then room; Piano opens
shots.exception: merged move on purpose: the reference median is 2.93 s per shot (the user asked for the 5B+5C merge on 2026-11-23)

shots.subject: As she sees him: an ordinary boy in an apron, staring, the cloth in his hand.
shots.camera: Over her blurred shoulder
shots.sound: Soft cloth, low piano

shots.subject: Her again. She glances away and back; her hand closes on her collar; the flush starts as 'and her heart was' begins.
shots.camera: Hushed push
shots.sound: Music out at the flush

shots.subject: Her collar and the fork jump with each beat; eye color opens. Then the camera pulls back past his blurred shoulder.
shots.camera: 0.6 percent punch and one 4 degree roll on the word, then the pull
shots.sound: Heartbeat and tick together on the word, then two more beats

shots.subject: Past his blurred shoulder: he has only just found her, and she is already looking. Color and flush fade.
shots.camera: Slow pull, no profiles
shots.sound: Room returns

shots.subject: An earlier day, one plate. She watches him straighten a slice with tongs, with great care, unaware.
shots.camera: Dissolve, slow push past her plate
shots.sound: Distant plate, soft piano

shots.subject: Her face in the hook's frame-0 framing again, cool. THEN: Face-matched dissolve: her whole face becomes his whole face, eyes aligned. Blurred backs close in on both sides.
shots.camera: Dissolve to the framing, push THEN: Same framing, 0.6 percent punch and 4 degree roll on 'EVERYONE'
shots.sound: A single tick; Scuffs from card 2, stopping on 'his.'
shots.exception: merged move on purpose: the reference median is 2.93 s per shot (the user accepted this in the hook)

shots.subject: Today. She takes her hand off the box and looks up. THEN: She says it plainly. No flush, no big smile. She breathes after 'scary'.
shots.camera: Two-shot gliding to her close-up, punch on 'never' THEN: Her close-up, drift
shots.sound: Piano alone; Almost dry voice
shots.exception: merged move on purpose: the reference median is 2.93 s per shot (the user accepted this in the hook)

shots.subject: It lands on him. From habit he glances at the door behind him.
shots.camera: His close-up, drift, rack to the door and back
shots.sound: Room

shots.subject: He steps aside to clear her way out on 'running'. The bell does not ring. THEN: His hand goes to the cloth, then the box, then nowhere.
shots.camera: Pull to a medium with the door behind him THEN: Medium, very slow push
shots.sound: One step; Cloth, a light touch on the box
shots.exception: merged move on purpose: the reference median is 2.93 s per shot (the user accepted this in the hook)

shots.subject: The mirror framing: her whole face in front, the mirror behind. She sits back into yesterday's seat. In the mirror he edges half a step away, then on 'stays' he stops, and stays. Both faces in one picture, both breathing to the last frame. His reflection's eyes settle out at the viewer for the last second.
shots.camera: Glide into the framing, drift
shots.sound: Room, chair settles on 'stays'
